frm.name: set_value
frm.signature: frm.set_value(fieldname: string | object, value?: any): Promise<void>
frm.returnDescription: Promise that resolves once the field value has been set and UI inputs re-rendered.
frm.docstring: Sets the value of a field on the current open Form and automatically updates the screen UI. If passing an object, it sets multiple fields simultaneously.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Fieldname to update or dictionary object of multiple field-value pairs.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to assign (omit if fieldname is an object).

frm.name: get_value
frm.returnDescription: Current field value from the form document (same as frm.doc[fieldname]).
frm.docstring: Retrieves the current in-memory value of a field from the open form.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: The fieldname of the field to read.

frm.name: save
frm.signature: frm.save(action?: string, callback?: () => void, btn?: any): Promise<void>
frm.returnDescription: Promise resolving after document save completes.
frm.docstring: Triggers the standard form save or submit action and runs client validation handlers.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Form action lifecycle command to trigger.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback invoked after successful save response.

parameters.name: btn
parameters.description: Triggering button element to freeze while saving.

frm.name: refresh
frm.docstring: Re-renders the form UI and triggers the `refresh` event handler.

frm.name: refresh_field
frm.docstring: Re-renders and updates a specific field's input control on the screen. Call this after directly modifying frm.doc.fieldname or child tables.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Fieldname of the field to refresh.

frm.name: set_df_property
frm.signature: frm.set_df_property(fieldname: string, property: string, value: any, docname?: string, table_field?: string): void
frm.docstring: Dynamically modifies a DocField property (e.g. `reqd`, `read_only`, `hidden`, `options`, `label`) on the active form.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New value to assign to the property.

parameters.name: docname
parameters.description: Child row docname if modifying a child table row.

parameters.name: table_field
parameters.description: Parent table fieldname if modifying a child table row.

frm.name: toggle_display
frm.signature: frm.toggle_display(fieldname: string | string[], show: boolean): void
frm.docstring: Shows or hides a form field (or array of fields) dynamically based on condition.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Fieldname or array of fieldnames to toggle.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Set true to display, false to hide.

frm.name: toggle_enable
frm.signature: frm.toggle_enable(fieldname: string | string[], enable: boolean): void
frm.docstring: Enables or disables user input on a field or array of fields.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: Set true to enable, false to disable/read-only.

frm.name: toggle_reqd
frm.signature: frm.toggle_reqd(fieldname: string | string[], reqd: boolean): void
frm.docstring: Toggles mandatory (required) status on a field or array of fields.

parameters.name: reqd
parameters.description: Set true to make mandatory, false otherwise.

frm.name: add_custom_button
frm.signature: frm.add_custom_button(label: string, action: () => void, group?: string): any
frm.returnDescription: jQuery object of the created button element.
frm.docstring: Adds a custom action button to the Form toolbar or inside a dropdown group.

frm.name: clear_custom_buttons
frm.docstring: Removes all custom buttons from the Form toolbar.

frm.name: set_query
frm.signature: frm.set_query(fieldname: string, callback: (doc: object, cdt?: string, cdn?: string) => object): void
frm.docstring: Applies custom filters or custom query method to a Link or Dynamic Link field.

frm.name: is_new
frm.returnDescription: True if document is newly created and not yet saved in database.
frm.docstring: Checks if current document is newly created in memory and not yet saved in the database.

frm.name: is_dirty
frm.returnDescription: True if form has unsaved modifications.
frm.docstring: Checks if the user has made unsaved edits to the current document form.

frm.name: add_child
frm.returnDescription: Newly created child table row doc object.
frm.docstring: Appends a new child row into a child table field on the form and returns the new row object.

parameters.name: table_fieldname
parameters.description: Child Table fieldname on parent DocType.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Initial field values dictionary for the new child row.

frm.name: set_intro
frm.docstring: Displays an introductory alert banner message above the form fields.
frm.example: frm.set_intro(__("Please verify all customer shipping addresses before approving."), "blue");

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Message string to render in banner.

frm.name: call
frm.signature: frm.call(opts_or_method: string | object, args?: object): Promise<any>
frm.returnDescription: Promise resolving with server controller method response.
frm.docstring: Calls a backend Python controller method defined on this Document's server class.

parameters.name: opts_or_method
parameters.description: Server controller method name or configuration object.

frm.name: reload_doc
frm.docstring: Reloads the document from the server database and re-renders the Form.

frm.name: print_doc
frm.docstring: Opens the print previewer dialog for this document.

frm.name: email_doc
frm.docstring: Opens the email composer dialog with this document attached as PDF.

frm.name: change_custom_button_type
frm.signature: frm.change_custom_button_type(label: string, group: string, type: string): void
frm.docstring: Changes visual style / bootstrap color class of a custom button.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Button group name or null if top-level.

frm.name: clear_table
frm.returnDescription: None (Empties all rows from child table).
frm.docstring: Removes all child rows from specified child table field.

frm.name: scroll_to_field
frm.docstring: Smoothly scrolls form view to target field input.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Target fieldname to smoothly scroll form viewport into focus.

frm.name: disable_save
frm.docstring: Disables standard Save button in form toolbar.

parameters.name: disable
parameters.description: Set True to hide/disable Save button, False to restore.

frm.name: enable_save
frm.docstring: Re-enables standard Save button in form toolbar.

frm.name: get_field
frm.returnDescription: Control object of the specified field containing `.grid`, `.$wrapper`, `.df`.
frm.docstring: Retrieves the UI control object for a field on the form.

frm.name: set_read_only
frm.docstring: Puts all fields in the form into read-only mode and disables saving.

grid.name: add_new_row
grid.signature: grid.add_new_row(idx?: number, callback?: (row: object) => void): object
grid.returnDescription: The newly created child table grid row instance.
grid.docstring: Programmatically adds a new row to a child table grid and triggers standard row render events. You can specify the row insertion index and a callback function to populate values.

parameters.name: idx
parameters.description: Target index position where the new row should be placed.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback executed after row is appended.

grid.name: get_selected
grid.returnDescription: Array of selected row docnames (cdn values).
grid.docstring: Returns the names of all checked / selected rows in the child table grid.

grid.name: get_selected_children
grid.returnDescription: Array of selected child row document objects.
grid.docstring: Returns the full document objects of all checked / selected rows in the child table grid.

grid.name: grid_rows
grid.docstring: Array of all visible GridRow instances in the child table.

grid.name: refresh
grid.docstring: Re-renders the child table grid rows, columns, and pagination on screen.

grid.name: refresh_row
grid.docstring: Re-renders a specific child row in the grid table without re-rendering the entire grid.

grid.name: set_column_disp
grid.docstring: Dynamically shows or hides a column in the child table grid table.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: True to show column, false to hide.

grid.name: toggle_reqd
grid.docstring: Toggles mandatory requirement on a column in the child table grid.

grid.name: toggle_enable
grid.docstring: Enables or disables user editing on a column in the child table grid.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: True to enable input, false to make read-only.

grid.name: toggle_display
grid.docstring: Shows or hides a child table column on screen.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: True to display, false to hide.

grid.name: open_form
grid.docstring: Opens the child row edit modal form popup for a specific row in the grid.

grid.name: remove_all
grid.docstring: Removes all child rows from the grid and updates the parent form.

grid.name: cannot_add_rows
grid.docstring: Flag that prevents users from adding new rows to the child table grid via UI.

listview.name: refresh
listview.docstring: Re-queries the database and refreshes the ListView table rows.

listview.name: get_checked_items
listview.returnDescription: Array of checked row objects with docname and fields.
listview.docstring: Returns all checked / selected document rows in the ListView.

listview.name: clear_checked_items
listview.docstring: Unchecks all selected rows in the ListView.

listview.name: select_all
listview.docstring: Selects / checks all visible rows in the ListView.

page.name: set_title
page.docstring: Sets header title text on custom workspace Page.

page.name: set_indicator
page.docstring: Displays colored status badge in page navigation bar.

page.name: add_inner_button
page.signature: page.add_inner_button(label: string, action: () => void, group?: string): any
page.docstring: Adds sub-action button inside page toolbar or dropdown group.

page.name: remove_inner_button
page.docstring: Removes an inner action button from the page toolbar.

page.name: add_field
page.docstring: Adds dynamic filter input control into page header toolbar.
page.example: const dateField = page.add_field({ fieldtype: "Date", label: "From Date", fieldname: "from_date" });

page.name: set_primary_action
page.signature: page.set_primary_action(label: string, action: () => void, icon?: string): any
page.docstring: Configures standard bold primary action button in top right of page.

page.name: set_secondary_action
page.signature: page.set_secondary_action(label: string, action: () => void, icon?: string): any
page.docstring: Configures secondary action button in page header.

page.name: clear_inner_toolbar
page.docstring: Removes all custom buttons and dropdowns from the page toolbar.

page.name: add_menu_item
page.signature: page.add_menu_item(label: string, action: () => void, standard?: boolean): void
page.docstring: Adds a menu item under the standard 'Menu' dropdown in the page header.

page.name: add_action_item
page.docstring: Adds an action item under the 'Actions' dropdown in the page header.
